Summary of what I pulled so far (preliminary):
- Verified clustered spike of 500/503s between 07:46:10 and 08:08:15 PDT (22m05s).
- Root cause appears to be a transient routing flap where ~12% of FastCart requests were routed to a eu-west fallback pool that had not finished warming (cold KV cache + suboptimal kernel path), causing elevated tail latencies and 503s for short requests that timed out on the client side.
- No GPU preemption events in us-west during the interval; us-west serving nodes showed normal CPU/GPU utilization but the hybrid router made aggressive failover choices when several edge nodes returned elevated error rates.

Provisional eligibility note: per SLO (90-day availability objective, failover policy exceptions section), this looks like it may be eligible for proportional credit because the serving layer returned 503s (not client misconfiguration). I will produce a packet with raw traces + per-request hashes to match to FastCart IDs.

I'll assemble a proposed credit calc for Jonas to review (will attach spreadsheet).

— David
SRE Lead, Redwood Inference

Samir — quick update and next steps.

Thanks for the request IDs you sent earlier; we matched three representative traces and completed a preliminary verification. Key points:
1) Verified impact window: 2025-10-19 07:46:10 PDT — 2025-10-19 08:08:15 PDT (22m05s).
2) Cause: routing fallback to partially warmed eu-west serving pool where KV cache cold starts produced elevated tail latency and a subset of 503s. No evidence of GPU preemption or backend hardware failure.
3) Eligibility: preliminary adjudication indicates FastCart is eligible for a proportional SLO credit under section 5.2 (fallback-induced errors). We will finalize the calculation after a short data reconciliation (attached worksheet).

Action items we are proposing:
- We will provide a full raw-trace bundle and reconciled credit calculation by EOD tomorrow (2025-10-22). Attachment: proposed-credit-calc-DC3847.xlsx.
- Schedule a 45-minute postmortem call for 2025-10-23 to walk causes, mitigations, and runbook updates. Laura will send the calendar invite.
- Immediate mitigations: we will pin FastCart routes to the more conservative routing policy for 72 hours and accelerate cache-warmup preloading for the eu-west pool. Priyom will follow up with the routing config change details.

If that plan works for you we will proceed and include the final credit as a one-line invoice adjustment once reconciled. Apologies for the impact — we take checkout availability seriously.

Jonas Weber
Account Lead, Redwood Inference
